title: Source manifest
description: Every source a call used, with a SHA-256 so CI can prove nothing changed after capture. Stored at data/<TICKER>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/sources/manifest.json. kind=file: a copy saved next to this manifest. kind=repo: a file in this repository at a pinned commit (used by the backfill, where the published report is the source).

path.description: kind=file: path relative to this sources/ directory. kind=repo: repository path at 'commit'.

original_sha256.description: Hash of the full response when the saved file is a filtered slice of it.
